# Indore Realty

> Indore Realty helps families and investors buy verified new 1, 2 and 3 BHK flats and residential projects in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. Founder, CEO & MD: Subhash Pawar. Website and technology by MLHK Infotech (https://mlhk.in).

Every project page shares the brochure, floor plans, unit sizes, price list, amenities and specifications upfront, and visitors can book a site visit or enquire on WhatsApp.

## Projects

- [All New Projects](/projects): Current residential projects in Indore.
- [Prabhu Krishna Embrace](/projects/prabhu-krishna-embrace): Premium 2 & 3 BHK flats (1360–1925 sq.ft), G+6 tower with 48 homes, rooftop clubhouse, gym and 20+ amenities.
- [Rudra Palace, Pulak City](/projects/rudra-palace-pulak-city): 1 & 2 BHK flats (525–1120 sq.ft) near Silicon City at ₹4600/sq.ft, from ₹24.15 Lakh.
